grades.main_gap: Core finiteness lemma (only finitely many primes appear) is unproven; backward extension of periodicity to all n is unproven; ubiquitous-prime lemma (Claim 4) unverified.
grades.notes: Correct framework and key observation (candidates = multiples of minimal hitting-set products), plus a valid conditional argument that prime-finiteness implies tail periodicity via merge of arithmetic progressions. Only the trivial Lemma 1 is proven unconditionally; the two hardest parts are explicitly left open, and the stated D≠∅ conjecture is contradicted by the write-up's own data.
